value.rationale: S4 is the first symmetric group in which subgroup flags support two-dimensional conjugation-orbit cells, yet those cells collapse to a nontrivial one-dimensional orbit loop. The result completes a natural low-rank comparison with elementary S3 and previously studied S5 and provides explicit incidence and homotopy data rather than a routine numerical invariant.
